name: Crois
source:
When Alice is walking through town, she finds a mysterious girl collapsed by the roadside ─ this is Crois. She works as a close aide to the queen, secretly carrying out various investigations under her orders.

However, Crois is also a natural-born criminal who repeatedly steals without remorse. Taking bread from bakeries when hungry and emptying shop registers when she's broke.

After repeatedly stealing, Crois found herself banned from every shop in town, eventually collapsing from hunger. It was Alice who came to her rescue. Ever since, Crois seems to hold special feelings for Alice, who regularly feeds her...

On dates with Crois, gently accepting her outrageous behavior and enjoying lots of bread together may bring you closer to her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3562120/view/523104697900335336] Steam [/url]]
